resolution: Replaced generated-atlas dominant-world-axis box projection with intrinsic planar chart bases, so equal physical faces retain equal UV scale and repeat-stack shape regardless of object rotation. Existing normalized/saved UV reconstruction stays on its historical path and is not silently migrated; the change takes effect only on an explicit atlas remake. Added a six-sided-cylinder rotation regression and ran the complete model_paint Zig unit suite: 28/28 passing.
